island.remettre_ile_haut_centre: Move the island back to the top center
search.rechercher_apps_fichiers_web: Search apps, files or the web
settings.demarrage_modules_opaline_tout: Opaline's startup and modules. Everything applies right away.
settings.opaline_ouvre_automatiquement_a: Opaline opens automatically when you sign in.
settings.pilule_haut_ecran_musique: The pill at the top of the screen (music, calendar, controls).
settings.desactive_barre_taches_windows: When off, the Windows taskbar comes back automatically.
settings.barre_menus_haut_ecran: Menu bar at the top of the screen
settings.gauche_menu_app_verrouiller: On the left the app menu (lock, sleep, restart, shut down) and the app in front, the island in the middle, and on the right weather, volume, network, battery (if the PC has one) and the time. Hidden in full screen and in games.
settings.fenetres_agrandies_arretent_sou: Maximized windows stop below the bar, just like with the taskbar.
settings.vrai_flou_windows_11: The real Windows 11 blur, like under the dock bar (tint: bar opacity, Appearance page).
settings.raccourci_fait_sortir_barre: The shortcut pulls a search bar out of the island: apps, folders, math (“15% of 80”), profiles, timer (“timer 10 min”).
settings.clique_ici_puis_appuie: Click here, then press the key combination
settings.couleurs_transparence_animation: Colors, transparency and animations of the island, the dock and settings.
settings.code_couleur_rrggbb_deux: Color code #RRGGBB (two codes = gradient). Press Enter to apply.
settings.lueur_couleur_accent_autour: Accent-colored glow around the island and the dock (0% = classic shadow).
settings.accent_halo_prennent_couleurs: The accent, glow and glass tint take the colors of your wallpaper (Wallpaper Engine included) and glide smoothly to the new ones when it changes. Off = fixed color, the profile's.
settings.teinter_ile_dock: Tint the island and the dock
settings.avec_couleurs_fond_ecran: With wallpaper colors: the black background takes a very dark shade of the image.
settings.windows_prend_couleur_app: Windows takes the app's color (Start menu, selections, Settings…). Turning it off restores your exact original color.
settings.fleche_degrade_accent_pastille: Accent-gradient arrow, dot for links, text bar (shapes made by the app). Follows the accent color; turning it off restores your exact original cursor.
settings.bord_refracte_legerement_lisere: A slightly refracting edge, a bright rim and a highlight on the island, the palette and the dock. Turned off automatically in Gaming mode.
settings.force_refraction_lisere_reflet: Strength of the refraction, rim and highlight.
settings.lumiere_tourne_vers_curseur: The light turns toward the cursor when it gets close; otherwise it always comes from above.
settings.dock_mode_flottant_moins: And of the floating dock. Less opaque = you can see more of what's behind.
settings.vrai_flou_windows_11_2: The real Windows 11 blur under the bottom bar (“Bar” layout only).
settings.teinte_sombre_par_dessus: Dark tint over the blur (0% = blur only).
settings.presque_carre_0_pilule: From almost square (0%) to a pill (100%).
settings.taille_icones_sans_grossissemen: Icon size, without the hover magnification.
settings.cinq_fonds_originaux_dessines: Five original wallpapers drawn by the app, a wallpaper that follows the time of day and an animated wallpaper behind the icons.
settings.il_dessine_par_dessus: It draws over the Windows wallpaper: the profile wallpaper and the dynamic wallpaper aren't visible while it runs. Opaline's animated wallpaper, however, goes in front of it (pause Wallpaper Engine to save resources).
settings.fond_dynamique_selon_heure: Dynamic wallpaper by time of day
settings.aurore_bouge_lentement_couleurs: A slowly moving aurora, in the colors of the hour if the dynamic wallpaper is on. Paused in games, when an app is full screen, on battery and when the session is locked.
settings.sinon_seulement_ecran_principal: Otherwise, only on the main screen.
settings.comment_pilule_reagit_souris: How the pill reacts to the mouse.
settings.delai_avant_ile_agrandisse: Delay before the island expands. Longer = fewer accidental openings.
settings.delai_avant_ile_retracte: Delay before the island shrinks back when the mouse leaves.
settings.video_jeu_plein_ecran: Video (YouTube, Netflix, video player…) or app in fullscreen on the island's screen, even if you click on another screen.
settings.barres_suivent_son_joue: The bars follow the sound that's playing (Windows level meter, no recording).
settings.pendant_musique_halo_prend: While music plays, the glow takes the album art's main color.
settings.point_vert_webcam_est: Green dot when the webcam is in use, orange for the microphone.
settings.volume_change_ile_affiche: When the volume changes, the island shows it for a moment.
settings.demarre_toute_seule_apres: Starts by itself after the focus session.
settings.glisser_ile_deplace_plus: Dragging the island no longer moves it (a click opens it right away).
settings.ile_passe_ecran_trouve: The island moves to the screen where the mouse is, at the same place (otherwise: the screen where you put it).
settings.dock_passe_ecran_souris: The dock moves to the screen where the mouse stops, on the same edge (otherwise: the screen chosen above). During a game, it doesn't go to the game's screen.
settings.parle_salon_vocal: Who's talking in your voice channel
settings.avatars_ile_reduite_anneau: Avatars in the compact island (green ring = talking) and a “Voice” tab. Uses Discord's official local API: nothing is sent anywhere else.
settings.application_id_appli_discord: Your app's “Application ID” on discord.com/developers (press Enter to apply).
settings.mini_claude_ile: Mini AI assistant in the island
settings.onglet_claude_question_palette: A “Claude” (or “ChatGPT”) tab and “? your question” in the palette. Choose the engine below: Claude Code with your Claude plan or Codex with your ChatGPT plan (no key), or a pay-as-you-go Anthropic or OpenAI API key. The assistant has no access to any file or tool.
settings.comportement_dock_barre_taches: Behavior of the dock and the Windows taskbar. Apps are managed from the dock (right-click, drag and drop).
settings.fine_toute_largeur_bas: Thin, across the whole bottom, like a taskbar: search on the left, background icons on the right.
settings.centre_detache_bord_facon: Centered and away from the edge, macOS style.
settings.fais_glisser_fond_dock: Drag the dock's background (not an icon) to another screen, or to the top of the screen. The floating dock also slides along the edge (it snaps to the center).
settings.icones_ouvrent_vers_bas: Icons open downward. The Genie effect is only used with the dock at the bottom.
settings.glisser_fond_dock_deplace: Dragging the dock's background no longer moves it.
settings.toutes_icones_meme_cadre: All icons in the same dark squircle frame. Right-click a pinned app → “Change icon…” to use your own image.
settings.icones_redessinees_seule_couleu: Icons redrawn in a single color: the accent gradient (shadows and highlights kept).
settings.toujours_visible_fenetres_maxim: Always visible. Maximized windows stop above the dock.
settings.cache_fenetre_touche_revient: Hides when a window touches it, comes back when the mouse goes to the bottom of the screen.
settings.toujours_cache_apparait_seuleme: Always hidden: appears only when the mouse touches the bottom of the screen.
settings.tous_ecrans_elle_revient: On all screens. It comes back by itself if the app closes, crashes or is stopped.
settings.nordvpn_discord_steam_droite: NordVPN, Discord, Steam… on the right of the dock (notification area).
settings.taille_maximale_icones_sous: Maximum size of the icons under the mouse (×1 = no effect).
settings.fenetre_reduite_ecoule_son: A minimized window flows into its dock icon. Windows' minimize animation is turned off while the app runs (it comes back when the app closes).
settings.onglet_widgets_ile_mesures: The island's “Widgets” tab (measured only while it's open) and widgets placed on the desktop.
settings.poses_fond_ecran_nets: Placed on the wallpaper: sharp when you're on the desktop, faded as soon as an app is in front. Drag them wherever you like (they snap to a grid), use the bottom-right handle to resize, right-click for the menu.
settings.jour_grand_samedi_date: The day in big letters (“SATURDAY”), the date and the time.
settings.pochette_titre_precedent_lectur: Album art, title, previous / play / next.
settings.mois_cours_aujourd_hui: The current month, today in the accent color.
settings.processeur_memoire_carte_graphi: Processor, memory, graphics card and network (measured every 2 s, stopped in games).
settings.plus_deplacement_ni_changement: No more moving or resizing (buttons still work).
settings.chaque_profil_ses_apps: Each profile has its own dock apps, accent color and wallpaper. Switch profiles in one click in the island (Controls tab) or with the dock's profile dot. Double-click a profile to activate it.
settings.jeu_passe_plein_ecran: When a game goes full screen (exclusive or borderless window), the island becomes a simple line and the dock hides. Everything comes back when you quit the game or it goes to the background.
settings.ces_applis_plein_ecran: These full-screen apps don't trigger Gaming mode (videos, browsers…): the island and the dock simply hide, as before. Process name, without “.exe”.
settings.envoie_theme_potes_installe: Send your theme to your friends, install theirs, and keep the app up to date.
settings.couleurs_transparence_arrondis_: Colors, transparency, roundness, dock style and your profiles with their apps and web shortcuts. Double-clicking the file installs it on your friend's PC.
settings.tous_mes_profils_sinon: All my profiles (otherwise only the active profile)
settings.ses_profils_sont_ajoutes: Its profiles are added next to yours (nothing is deleted) and its style applies right away. You can go back to your profile in one click.
settings.demarrage_puis_chaque_jour: At startup, then every day. A new version is announced in the island; nothing is installed without your click.
settings.nouvelles_versions_sont_prises: New versions are taken from this repository's “Releases” (owner/name, press Enter to apply).
settings.ile_dock_widgets_windows: An island, a dock and widgets for Windows 11 — in opal glass.
settings.presentation_premier_lancement_: The first-launch tour: profile, style, wallpaper, modules.
settings.utile_si_quelque_chose: Useful if something doesn't work as expected.
settings.managedshell_zone_notification_: ManagedShell (notification area) — Apache-2.0, cairoshell / RetroBar project.
settings.barre_taches_windows_revient: The Windows taskbar comes back automatically.
music.volume_appli_joue_musique: Volume of the app playing music (the Windows volume doesn't change)
music.lance_spotify_video_youtube: Start Spotify or a YouTube video
shelf.glisse_fichiers_ile_garder: Drag files onto the island to keep them here
shelf.depose_garder_etagere: Drop to keep on the shelf
widgets.active_parametres_widgets: Turn them on in Settings → Widgets
welcome.title: Welcome to {0}
welcome.intro: An island, a dock and widgets for Windows 11, in opal glass. One minute to set everything up — you can change it all later in settings.
welcome.profiles.title: Mostly for what?
welcome.profiles.description: Each profile has its own dock apps, its color and, if you like, its wallpaper. Switch between them in one click from the island (Controls tab).
welcome.profile.perso: Your dock and your color, for every day.
welcome.profile.gaming: Steam, Discord and your launchers; red and magenta.
welcome.profile.stage: Outlook, Word, Excel; blue and teal.
welcome.profile.etudes: Word, OneNote, Excel; green and teal.
welcome.style.title: Your style
welcome.style.description: The accent color tints the island's glow, the rims and everything that's active. It belongs to the chosen profile.
welcome.style.wallpaper_colors.descripti: The accent and the glass tint are taken from your wallpaper and smoothly follow it when it changes.
welcome.style.glass.description: Slightly refracting edges and a highlight that follows the mouse (light, off in games).
welcome.wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
welcome.wallpaper.description: Five wallpapers drawn by Opaline, in black, blue and purple. Your current wallpaper is kept aside: it comes back if you change your mind or uninstall.
welcome.wallpaper.dynamic.description: The chosen design follows the sun: dawn, day, sunset, night (one image every 10 min at most).
welcome.modules.title: What you want to see
welcome.modules.description: Nothing changes before “Let's go”. Everything that touches Windows is reversible: turning it off later in the settings (or quitting Opaline) puts everything back as it was.
welcome.modules.taskbar.description: It comes back if Opaline closes.
welcome.modules.menubar.description: At the top: app, weather, time.
welcome.done.title: All set!
welcome.tip.move: Drag the island or the dock's background wherever you like: another screen, bottom, top.
welcome.tip.dock: {0}: the dock appears, even in games.
welcome.tip.settings: Settings: click the {0} icon among the background icons (on the right of the dock, or near the clock if the taskbar is shown), or right-click the dock.

settings.mica.description: On this window. Windows can't blur the island and dock shapes: they use the opacity below.
settings.mica.unavailable: Unavailable here (Windows 11 22H2 and transparency effects required): solid background.
settings.auto_theme.restore: Turning it off restores your original theme.
settings.hotkey.help: Click in the box, then press the combination (Ctrl, Alt or Win + a key). Off during Gaming mode.
settings.reveal_hotkey.help: Shows the dock on top of everything, even in games or full screen (6 s, and as long as the mouse is over it; press again to hide it). Also works during Gaming mode.

placement.screen.other: The dock stays usable on this screen while a game runs on another one.

wallpaper.dynamic.description: The chosen design gently takes on the colors of dawn, day, sunset and night.
wallpaper.dynamic.restore: Turning it off restores the profile wallpaper.

discord.denied_detail: Access denied in Discord ({0}). Click “Sign in” to try again.

updates.status.no_installer: Version {0} is published, but without an .exe installer.
theme.error.too_big: File too big for a theme.
theme.error.newer: Theme made by a newer version of the app: update it.
voice.setup: Set it up in Settings → Island → Discord.
voice.join: Join a voice channel: you'll see who's talking here.
sun.today: Today: light from {0} to {1}, dark afterwards. {2}.
dynamic.polar: Polar day or night: fixed colors today.
dynamic.describe: Current colors: {0}. Dawn from {1}, sunset around {2}, night from {3}.

settings.status.title: Items on the right of the dock
settings.status.description: Separated from the apps by a thin line. Choose which ones to show and their order (left to right).
settings.status.keyboard.description: FR, EN… of the app you're typing in. Click: next language, right-click: all languages.
settings.status.updates.description: Pending updates and required restarts, checked in the background every 3 h (not in games). Opaline never installs or restarts anything.
settings.status.trash.description: Drop a file on it to move it to the Recycle Bin (recoverable). Right-click: empty, with confirmation.
settings.status.downloads.description: Your latest downloads, to open or drag wherever you like.
settings.status.desktop.description: Small arrow: one click hides or brings back the desktop icons (same setting as “Hide desktop icons” above).
settings.status.mixer.description: One click opens the mixer in the island (volume of each app); the scroll wheel sets the main volume.
status.mixer.help: Click: mixer in the island · scroll: volume
mixer.empty: No app is playing sound right now.
settings.desktop_icons.description: Keeps the desktop clear. The small arrow in the status area (added when you turn this on) brings them back or hides them in one click. Nothing is changed in Windows: they come back as soon as you turn this or the dock off, or close Opaline, even after a crash.
settings.dock.alignment.description: Bar: in the middle, right after search (left) or right before the status area (right). Floating dock: centered, or against that side of the screen.
settings.dock.close_size.description: The “×” that closes a window when you hover its preview (above an open app's icon).
settings.dock.close_color.description: Discreet gray, clearly visible red, or the profile's accent color.
settings.status.keyboard_island: Keyboard language in the island too
settings.status.keyboard_island.descript: When you switch language (Win+Space or click), the island shows it briefly.
settings.notices.devices.description: Bluetooth headphones, controller, USB drive: name and battery (if Windows provides it) in the island when they connect.
settings.notices.downloads.description: A new file in Downloads shows up in the island: click to open it, or drag the notice to a folder or an app.
settings.clocks.title: Cities
settings.clocks.description: Up to 4 cities, with their time in the island's “Clocks” tab. The time zone is looked up once online (Open-Meteo), then the time is computed on this PC.
settings.clocks.full: {0} cities at most: remove one to add another.
settings.connected.subtitle: Control your PC from your phone, on your local network.
settings.remote.toggle.desc: Music, volume, mic, profiles and PC lock from a web page on your phone. Local network only, off by default.
settings.remote.pairing.title: Scan this code with your phone
settings.remote.pairing.text: Use the phone's camera, on the same Wi-Fi as the PC. Or open the address below and type the code. Valid for {0}.
settings.remote.ready.text: Open this address on a linked phone (add it to its home screen), or add another phone.
settings.remote.paired: {0} is linked! Add the page to its home screen to find it again.
settings.remote.public.title: Your network is set to “Public”
settings.remote.public.text: For your safety, the remote only listens on a “Private” network. Set {0} to “Private” in the Windows network settings (Network profile type): it starts on its own afterwards.
settings.remote.port.title: Port {0} is already in use
settings.remote.port.text: Another app is using this port. Close it, then turn the remote off and on again.
settings.remote.stopped.text: Safe mode, or the module was stopped after an error: it comes back the next time Opaline starts.
settings.remote.firewall.confirm:
So your phone can reach the PC, Opaline will add a Windows Firewall rule:

• only for Opaline, on port {0};
• only on “Private” networks (never on public Wi-Fi).

Windows will ask for administrator permission. The rule is removed when you turn the remote off (Windows will ask again).
settings.remote.firewall.refused: Cancelled: without the firewall rule, your phone can't reach the PC. The remote stays off.
settings.remote.firewall.failed: The firewall rule couldn't be added (details in the log). The remote stays off.
settings.remote.firewall.kept: The remote is off, but the firewall rule is still there (administrator window declined). You can remove it below.
settings.remote.firewall.left.desc: It opens nothing while the remote is off (nothing is listening), but you can remove it.
settings.remote.note: Nothing goes through the Internet: the phone talks straight to the PC on your network. The connection isn't encrypted: keep the remote for your home network.
remote.page.title: Opaline Remote
remote.page.pair.title: Link this phone
remote.page.pair.text: On the PC: Opaline Settings → Connected → “Add a phone”, then type the code shown.
remote.page.pair.wrong: Wrong code. Check the code shown on the PC.
remote.page.pair.closed: Pairing is closed or expired. Click “Add a phone” again on the PC.
remote.page.pair.full: Too many linked phones: remove one in the PC settings.
remote.page.offline: Can't reach the PC. Is Opaline running, and is the phone on the same Wi-Fi?
remote.page.forget.confirm: This phone won't be able to control the PC without a new code. Continue?
remote.page.forgotten: This phone is no longer linked to the PC.
settings.remote.full.tip: Sleep, restart, shut down and reading the PC clipboard from this phone (no confirmation).
settings.remote.full.note: “Full control”: this phone can also put the PC to sleep, restart it, shut it down (right away, no confirmation) and read its clipboard.
settings.wake: Turn the PC on from your phone
settings.wake.desc: A PC that is off no longer answers the page: a “Wake on LAN” app on the phone wakes it (for example Mocha WOL on iPhone), with the details below. You also need to set the BIOS once (Del key at startup): ErP “Disabled” and wake by network card enabled (Wake on LAN / Resume by PCI-E).
settings.wake.no_adapter: No wired network card connected: remote wake rarely works over Wi-Fi.
settings.wake.info:
Card: {0}
MAC address: {1}   ·   Broadcast address: {2}   ·   Port: 9
settings.wake.ready: Windows is ready. The BIOS (once) and the phone app are left.
settings.wake.not_ready: Windows isn't ready yet: “Prepare the PC” takes care of it.
settings.wake.confirm:
Opaline will set your network card ({0}) so it can wake the PC:

• “Wake on Magic Packet” on;
• allowed to wake the PC from sleep.

Your Internet connection drops for 2 or 3 seconds. Windows will ask for administrator permission. “Undo” reverts everything.
settings.wake.prepared: Done: the network card can wake the PC.
settings.wake.undone: The network card is back as it was.
settings.wake.failed: That didn't work (details in the log): nothing changed.
remote.page.denied: Needs “Full control”: turn it on for this phone in Settings → Connected.
remote.page.link.title: Open a link on the PC
remote.page.send.title: Send to the PC
remote.page.send.text: Photos and files, saved to Downloads.
remote.page.send.space: Not enough space on the PC.
remote.page.text.title: Text to the PC
remote.page.message.title: Message in the island
remote.page.power.title: Power
remote.page.power.full: Turn on “Full control” for this phone (Settings → Connected) for sleep, restart and shut down.

settings.friends.guide:
Create your free server (only once, about 5 min; one server is enough for your whole group of friends):
1. Create a free Cloudflare account (“Open Cloudflare” button).
2. Storage & Databases → D1 → Create database, name “opaline-amis”.
3. Workers & Pages → Create → Worker → Deploy (the “Hello World”), then “Edit code”: delete everything, paste the code copied with “Copy the server code”, and Deploy.
4. In that Worker: Settings → Bindings → Add → D1 database, variable name “DB”, database “opaline-amis”.
5. Copy the Worker's address (https://….workers.dev), paste it above and Save. Give it to your friends too.

settings.stage.description: On each screen, the active window in the middle and the others minimized as thumbnails in a column on the left.
settings.stage.details: Click a thumbnail to bring it to the middle. A new window takes the middle. Left alone: games, full screen, “always on top” windows, apps running as administrator and ignored apps. Turning it off puts everything back as it was.
settings.stage.hotkey.help: Turns Stage Manager on or off (none by default; released during games). Delete or Backspace: no shortcut.
settings.rules.stage.tooltip: Stage Manager: “ignore” = its windows are never minimized or moved

settings.stage.fill.description: The window in the middle takes all the space next to the thumbnails
settings.stage.autohide.description: The thumbnails slide off the screen; touch the left edge with the mouse to bring them back. The window in the middle then takes the full width
palette.stage.always: Stage Manager: always show the column
palette.stage.autohide: Stage Manager: hide the column automatically
palette.stage.column.description: Thumbnail column on the left of the screen
palette.stage.peek.alias: show windows column reveal see thumbnails
palette.stage.peek.description: Brings out the column on the mouse's screen for 4 s
opal.demo.title: Opal glass
opal.demo.subtitle: Three intensities to compare on your wallpaper. Move the mouse: the reflections follow. Hover a tile to see its glow.
opal.demo.note: The chosen style is applied to the whole app right away. Here, the blur is simulated from the backdrop.
opal.demo.sample.title: Sample title
opal.style.intense.description: Vivid opal, strong reflections and glows
settings.opal.title: Compare the three intensities
settings.opal.description: Sample island, tiles and dock side by side on your wallpaper.
welcome.style.opal.description: You can change it later in Settings → Appearance.
settings.opal_theme.description: The theme of the island, the dock, the palette, menus and this window. It changes smoothly and never touches the Windows theme.
opal.theme.dark.description: Dark opal glass, white text (as before)
opal.theme.light.description: Pearly white milky glass, dark text, pastel reflections, soft shadows
opal.theme.auto.description: Light between sunrise and sunset in the weather city, dark at night.
opal.theme.windows.description: Follows the Windows light / dark app mode
